title: Mixing: Tight A$ by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

The penultimate of 17 mixing sessions for John Lennon’s fourth solo album Mind Games took place on 13 September 1973.

The album sessions all took place at New York’s Record Plant studio. This was the second of three mixing sessions for ‘Tight A$’, following initial work on 4 September. The song was completed on 14 September.

Mixing sessions for Mind Games ran from 15 August to 14 September 1973.
